These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `POST /api/v1/repositories`

Register a git repository

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Registers a repository that environments can deploy, by name, URL and optionally a credential secret and known hosts. Deployers pick the name and never the URL. Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` on the instance. Answers 409 when the name is taken and 422 for a field that is not valid.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RepositoryCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `kind` | one of `local`, `https`, `ssh` | yes |  |
| `url` | text | yes |  |
| `credential_secret` | text or null | no |  |
| `credential_username` | text or null | no |  |
| `ssh_known_hosts` | text or null | no |  |
| `default_ref` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `RepositoryOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `RepositoryOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `kind` | text | yes |  |
| `url` | text | yes |  |
| `credential_secret` | text or null | yes |  |
| `credential_username` | text or null | yes |  |
| `ssh_known_hosts` | text or null | yes |  |
| `default_ref` | text or null | yes |  |
| `created_by` | text (uuid) or null | yes |  |
| `created_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `deploy_keys` | list of `RepositoryDeployKeyOut` | no |  |

## `PATCH /api/v1/repositories/{name}`

Change a repository

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Changes its URL, credential secret, username, known hosts or default ref. Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` on the instance; changing the URL of a repository whose secret is bound also needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in that environment. Answers 404 when no repository has that name and 422 when nothing is given or a field cannot be changed.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | The repository's registered name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RepositoryUpdate`

## `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}`

Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` on the instance. Answers 404 when no repository has that name and 409 while an environment still deploys it: undeploy it there first.

## `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/deploy-key`

Make an SSH deploy key for each environment, kept as that environment's secret

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Each environment gets a key pair of its own; the private key is stored as the environment's secret at once and never shown, the public keys are answered to add at the git host as read-only deploy keys. By default every environment where you may manage secrets and the repository has no key yet gets one, and the others are listed unchanged (`made` false) or as `skipped`. `environments` narrows the call; with `replace` their keys are replaced, and the old keys stop working. The repository then names the secret as its credential.

Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` on the instance and `MANAGE_SECRET` in each environment written, and an ssh repository with confirmed host keys. Answers 404 when no repository (or named environment) has that name, 409 when a secret of that name there is revoked, is not a key made for this repository or the repository names another secret, and 422 for `replace` without `environments` or a secret name that cannot be a credential.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | The repository's registered name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, optional): `DeployKeyIn` or null

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `secret` | text or null | no |  |
| `environments` | list of text or null | no |  |
| `replace` | true or false | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `DeployKeyOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `DeployKeyOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `secret` | text | yes |  |
| `keys` | list of `DeployKeyMadeOut` | yes |  |
| `skipped` | list of text | yes |  |
| `replaced` | list of text | yes |  |
| `notes` | list of text | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/repository-probes`

Queue a repository check; poll it with `GET /api/v1/repository-probes/{probe_id}`

``host_keys`` fetches the SSH host keys of `url`'s host and port, for the person to compare with the git host's published fingerprints before trusting any. ``access`` runs `git ls-remote` for registered `repository` with `environment`'s credential and the repository's own known hosts. Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` (and `READ_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment for ``access``). Answers 422 for a body without exactly its kind's fields or an unsafe URL, 404 for an unknown repository or environment, 409 while the caller has five checks waiting or running, and 503 when no worker that takes pipeline work is running. A check no worker takes within two minutes ends ``no_worker``; one a worker took ends at most 90 seconds later, so every check ends within three and a half minutes of its request.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RepositoryProbeIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of `host_keys`, `access` | yes |  |
| `url` | text or null | no |  |
| `repository` | text or null | no |  |
| `environment` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Successful Response | `RepositoryProbeOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `RepositoryProbeOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `kind` | text | yes |  |
| `state` | text | yes |  |
| `outcome` | text or null | yes |  |
| `message` | text or null | yes |  |
| `host_keys` | list of `HostKeyOut` or null | yes |  |
| `created_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `finished_at` | text (date-time) or null | yes |  |
